title: EMS Cloud Manager Configuration
description: MQTT broker connection, authentication, telemetry publish settings, and offline buffering configuration for cloud_manager. All cloud communication uses MQTT over TLS 1.3 with mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate authentication.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

broker.description: MQTT broker connection parameters. The EMS connects as a client to the cloud broker at site commissioning.

host.description: MQTT broker hostname or IP address. Example: mqtt.revx-energy.com

port.description: MQTT broker TCP port. Port 8883 is the standard MQTT over TLS port (MQTTS). Port 1883 is unencrypted MQTT (never use in production).

protocol.description: MQTT transport protocol. 'mqtts' = MQTT over TLS 1.3 (required for production); 'mqtt' = unencrypted (test/lab only).

auth.description: Authentication method and certificate paths for cloud broker connection. mTLS is required in production — both client and server certificates are verified.

method.description: Authentication method. 'mtls' = mutual TLS with client certificate (production); 'token' = bearer token (development/test).

ca_cert_path.description: Filesystem path to the CA certificate bundle for verifying the broker's TLS certificate. Example: /etc/ems/certs/ca.crt

client_cert_path.description: Filesystem path to this device's client certificate for mTLS authentication. Issued per device at commissioning. Example: /etc/ems/certs/device.crt

client_key_path.description: Filesystem path to this device's private key for mTLS authentication. Must be protected with filesystem permissions (0600). Example: /etc/ems/certs/device.key

telemetry.description: Telemetry publish rate and MQTT topic namespace. All data is published to {topic_prefix}/telemetry on the configured interval.

interval_s.description: Telemetry publish interval in seconds. Shorter intervals increase data granularity but increase cloud data ingestion costs. Typical: 60s.

topic_prefix.description: MQTT topic prefix for all messages from this site. Must match the site registration in the cloud platform. Example: ems/RES-001

offline_buffer.description: Local offline data buffer settings. When cloud connection is lost, telemetry is buffered locally and uploaded when connectivity resumes.

enabled.description: Enable offline data buffering. When true, telemetry is stored to local disk during connectivity loss. When false, data during outages is discarded.

max_hours.description: Maximum offline buffer retention in hours. Older data is discarded when this limit is reached. 24h covers typical daily maintenance windows.

max_mb.description: Maximum offline buffer size in megabytes. When exceeded, oldest data is deleted to make space. Set based on available storage on the ECU.
